title: Minimum decision tree size bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\alpha$, and let $T$ be a decision tree that computes $f$. The minimum number of leaves among decision trees computing $f$ is at most the number of leaves of $T$.
